sources.note: Field-filtered: the tagger's e-mail is dropped; every kept field is listed in the capture's filter key.

Only the four assets this pin uses. Each asset's GitHub digest equals its local sha256: the archive's and install.sh's in outputs/download-sha256.txt (lines 1-2), the two sidecars' in outputs/sidecar-sha256.txt (lines 1-2, recorded by capture-supplement.sh).

sources.value: install.sh downloads ai-memory-<target>.tar.gz and its .sha256 from the release named by AI_MEMORY_VERSION, refuses a missing or mismatched checksum before unpacking, unpacks under ~/.local/lib/ai-memory and links ~/.local/bin/ai-memory

proposed_run_pin.reason: The install plan installs the version the command center moved the host to (3.1.0), through the vendor's own installer, so the plan and the host run the same verified release. This is an install pin, not evidence that 3.1.0 is better than any survivor; the memory head-to-head still decides.

native_capture: outputs/upstream-tag-resolution.txt:1-2 (line 1 the annotated tag object, line 2 the commit it peels to)
outputs/github-api-tag.json (git_tag.tagger.date is the tagger date; git_tag.verification is verified false with reason unsigned)

release_archive.verification: sha256sum -c against the publisher's .sha256 sidecar, run in a fresh download directory; exit 0
release_archive.binary_note: The ai-memory file extracted from the verified archive (never run). The vendor's install.sh unpacks this file to ~/.local/lib/ai-memory/ai-memory.

install_script.verification: sha256sum -c against the publisher's install.sh.sha256 sidecar, run in a fresh download directory; exit 0. The same digest as the install.sh blob at the tagged commit, read through the GitHub contents API at 11ca7c5b (outputs/install-script-blob-at-tag.txt, recorded by capture-supplement.sh)

limits: No operational pin, catalog, canonical angle record or default changes; adoption/new-wsl-profile.json's head-to-head arm is untouched.
The vendor's install.sh verifies the archive against the release's sidecar at install time; the plan pins the installer's digest and checks the installed binary against binary_sha256.
Nothing was installed or run from these downloads: the archive was checksum-verified and one file was extracted to read its digest.
The 3.1.0 install on NativeHorizonNY is the command center's host change, recorded outside the repository; this record does not receipt it.
